name: banhmi-contagion
title: banh mi contagion
blurb: every public bluesky post that says banh mi, from the very first to now, drawn as an infection graph: who caught it, from whom (replies, quotes, mentions), as a d3-force cluster map on a scrubbable timeline, with a start-date picker, with the rate of change (1st and 2nd derivative) and the posts behind each jump or drop; counts the "bahn mi" misspelling too. @hailey.at asked what on earth is happening; @sqrt.fyi wanted the history. charts have resolution and smoothing sliders.
